sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Yehuda's request that the flow be drawn into him (Malchus) is explained through the principle that vessels have a higher root than lights, causing the lights to desire to clothe themselves in vessels for the sake of revelation even in lower worlds.

translations.translation: And based on this, we can explain what was brought above from the Torah of the Arizal, that the explanation of "Bi Adoni" is that through it the flow is drawn from Yosef HaTzaddik,
for at first glance,
since Yehuda requested this from Yosef,
he should have asked that he
(Yosef)
draw the flow to him,
and why did he ask of Yosef that in him
(Yehuda)
the flow be drawn?29
And we can say the explanation of this according to the known30
matter of lights and vessels
(for Zeir Anpin and Malchus
(Yosef and Yehuda)
are analogous to lights and vessels),
that the reason lights are drawn to clothe in vessels is because the root of the vessels is higher than the root of the lights,
and since in the lights the superiority of the vessels from the aspect of their root31 is felt,
therefore they are drawn to clothe in vessels.
And we can say,
that since lights are revelation,
therefore,
also the superiority of the vessels
(from the aspect of their root)
as it is felt in the lights, is that through the vessels the Unlimited is revealed within the matter of revelation
[for through the lights clothing in vessels,
they are drawn also into the worlds of Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah,
and even into this physical world].
And likewise is it with Zeir Anpin and Malchus,
that Zeir Anpin desires to bestow to Malchus
[for all bestowal is through will32]
because he feels the superiority of Malchus from the aspect of her root,
the main feeling is that through the bestowal to Malchus, the drawing down of Zeir Anpin will be in completeness
[for through Malchus,
it will be drawn also into Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah,
even into this world].
And therefore Yehuda said to Yosef "Bi Adoni",
that the drawing of flow from Zeir Anpin to Malchus should be
(not in order that the drawing down of Zeir Anpin be in completeness,
but rather)
in order that in Malchus the flow be drawn33,
"Bi Adoni".
And specifically through this, "you shall be like Pharaoh",
the ascent of Zeir Anpin to the Essence of Kesser.
For the aspect of Kesser that is revealed in Zeir Anpin through the drawing down of Zeir Anpin being drawn downward, downward,
the matter of the Unlimited
(of Kesser)
that is in His ability to be drawn downward, downward,
is the revelation of Kesser,
and through Yosef
(Zeir Anpin)
drawing the flow to Yehuda
(Malchus)
in order that in Malchus the flow be drawn
("Bi Adoni"),
through this there will be in him a revelation of the Essence of Kesser.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Since Zeir Anpin is revelation, Yehuda's request for a flow solely for Malchus seems incongruous, and this is explained through the concept that all Israel are intermingled like the Menorah, where through hammering, above descends below and below ascends above, making them one.

translations.translation: And explanation is needed,
for since the matter of Zeir Anpin
(Yosef)
is revelation,
it would seem that there cannot be in him a matter that is not revelation,
and how did Yehuda effect in Yosef the matter of "Bi Adoni",
that he should draw flow to Malchus for the sake of Malchus,
a drawing that is not relevant
(seemingly)
to the matter of revelations.
And this will be understood by prefacing34
what is explained in Likkutei Torah, Parshat Beha'alotecha, "the lights"35
and also in the discourses of Parshat Vayigash36
regarding the matter of "for your servant became surety for the lad" etc.37,
that the fact that Israel are guarantors for one another38
is because they are intermingled with one another
("areivim" [guarantors] meaning "me'uravim" [intermingled]).
For this is one of the reasons that the Congregation of Israel is compared to the Menorah
("a Menorah of pure gold"39),
for just as it is said of the Menorah40
"of hammered work shall the Menorah be made",
for through the hammering with which they hammer it, what is above descends below and what is below ascends above and everything becomes intermingled together,
so too all of Israel are intermingled
(and included)
with one another,
to the extent that there is found among them neither head nor end41.
And this is "you are called 'Adam'"42,
that all of Israel are
(like)
one man.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The unity of Israel as "one man" is higher than mere intermingling, reflecting both the mutual completion of distinct limbs and the deeper unity where all are a single essence, like the limbs of a body.

translations.translation: And we can say,
that this matter—that all of Israel are like one man—is higher than the matter that all of Israel are intermingled with one another.
For the term "intermingled with one another" applies to separate things that have become mixed together.
And so too is it regarding the matter of "of hammered work shall the Menorah be made",
that the inclusion of hammered work is in a manner that there exist the two matters of above and below,
except that they are intermingled with one another,
for what is above descends below and what is below ascends above.
But that all of Israel are like one man is above division.
And we can say43,
that this—"you are called 'Adam'"—is,
for also in the unity of the limbs of a human body there are two matters.
All the limbs complete one another,
for they all need one another.
For just as the head bestows upon the foot, so too the foot bestows upon the head.
And regarding this matter
(that the foot bestows upon the head)
the foot is called "head".
For in this inclusion there is the division of head and foot,
except that since every limb is a head
[for every limb has a unique superiority,
from which aspect it bestows upon all the limbs],
therefore,
their inclusion is in a manner that there is found among them neither head nor end.
And likewise is it with Israel,
that in each and every one of Israel there is a unique superiority,
and this superiority he bestows upon all the rest of Israel.
And it is found that all of Israel complete one another,
in a manner that there is found among them neither head nor end.
[That is,
there is a matter of head and end,
except that it is impossible to determine
(there is not found)
who is the head and who is the end].
And there is another matter in the unity of the limbs of a human body,
that its main point is that they are parts of the human body.
For this matter is equal in all the limbs.
And likewise is it with Israel,
that each and every one of Israel is a part of the entirety of Israel,
that from the aspect of this matter,
all of Israel are one essence44.
